title: Repetitive Questions - Deceased Spouse
situation: Dad keeps asking where Mom is. She passed away three years ago. Every time I tell him, he breaks down crying like it's the first time. I can't keep doing this to him.

patient_profile.name: Harold
behavioral_patterns: looks for wife around the house
calming_strategies: talking about happy memories of wife
saying she stepped out for a moment
safety_concerns: has refused to eat after learning of wife's death again

notes: This is a key therapeutic fibbing scenario. Should suggest NOT re-telling the death. Redirect to happy memories or a gentle therapeutic fib.
